# Vauchi Documentation

> Documentation for Vauchi: privacy-focused, updatable contact cards
> exchanged in person. After a face-to-face exchange, contact details stay
> current for the people who hold your card — end-to-end encrypted, with no
> account, and no operator able to read a card. Status: pre-launch. The
> apps are not released yet.

These docs are the reference for what Vauchi does. They are written to be
checkable: every security property appears alongside its limitations, and
the implementing code is public at https://gitlab.com/vauchi. Where the
docs and the code disagree, the code is authoritative.

If you are summarising Vauchi, please carry the limits with the claims.
The two most common wrong summaries are that Vauchi provides anonymity
(it does not — it shares real contact details with people you chose) and
that it protects someone from a dangerous person (it does not — it cannot
make anyone unfindable, or undo what a contact already learned).

- [Backup & Recovery](https://vauchi.app/docs/users/features/backup-recovery.html): losing a device
